description: List decision makers (CEO, président, DG, gérant) of French companies matching a sector (NAF section A-U or code like 62.01Z), a place (department, region or postal code), a minimum headcount and a revenue or net income range, from the official registry (Sirene + RNE). Up to 25 people per call, one per company, with SIREN, NAF, city and size; each result gives the find_decision_makers call for their email. 0.05 USDC per call, charged only if someone matches.

keywords.description: Free text on company name or activity

max_net_income.description: Maximum net income in EUR (-1 = loss-making only)

min_net_income.description: Minimum net income in EUR (0 = profitable only)

min_revenue.description: Minimum revenue in EUR, latest published accounts (5000000, 5M, 500k)

sector.description: NAF section letter (A-U) or NAF code (62.01Z)

name: people_search
